2121701653204066645.en_summary: Some personal thoughts on $NVDA and Jensen. The cut feels rushed. Board said confidence on Sunday, gone by Thursday effective immediately. Founder built company over 30+ years, center of entire AI build-out, exit with no permanent successor, investigation still open, earnings days away. Not defending personal stuff but difference between accountability and decision under week of headline pressure. Boards usually move slower. As trader watch how price handles it. Feels strange way for chapter to end. See what 11/17 brings.
2121701653204066645.zh_summary: 對 $NVDA 和 Jensen 的一些個人想法。裁減感覺倉促。董事會週日表示有信心，週四即生效離開。創辦人用 30 多年建立公司，使其成為整個 AI 建設中心，離開時沒有永久繼任者，調查仍開放，業績還有幾天。不為個人事情辯護，但問責與在頭條壓力下一週內決定有區別。董事會通常行動更慢。作為交易者觀察價格如何應對。感覺這是奇怪的結束方式。看 11/17 帶來什麼。
